title: The Wedding Songs Give Way to Battle at Dawn

blocks.text: Even on the threshold of combat the Singhs continue to surround Gurbakhsh Singh with devotional music. Gurbani verses were sung to the accompaniment of music, and the wedding imagery remains deliberate: the page insists that martyrdom should be entered with the same solemn joy that accompanies a sacred union.

That mood shifts with the first light. With the break of dawn did the Pathans arrive, and Gurbakhsh Singh answers not with fear but with exhortation, reminding the Panth that retreat would stain their honor when the Guru's cause has already summoned them forward.

His challenge is phrased as a rule for conduct in battle: A step taken ahead upholds a Singh's dignity. Hearing these words, the Singhs jumped all around, rushing toward the enemy with the eagerness of hunters closing upon deer and with death already accepted as their companion.
